q1_issues.issue: The bounded gap is recorded with a head the instruction set never defines, so 'more than' has no licensed encoding and the atom matches no question form the instructions describe.
The stated unit 'a decade' is silently converted to '10 year', against the rule that a measure is emitted in its stated unit unchanged and that the translator never does the arithmetic itself.

q2_gaps: bounded/inexact measured temporal gap ('more than a decade ago') — only the exact (BeforeBy e now n unit) form exists, and TimeAtLeast/TimeAtMost bound a time POINT, not a gap, so they are unusable with no TODAY or calendar anchor
'decade' as a time unit — no conversion factor is listed and no guidance says whether to keep it or expand it to years
notes: The light-verb-over-event-noun routing (no separate 'occur' event, Past directly on the story witness) and the demonstrative-definite witness are both correct.
